name: Flood Escape 2 🌊
desc:
The flood does not stop for anybody. Whether it be water, acid, or lava, you must stay dry at all costs by pressing buttons and working as a team to escape the flood! With over 150+ community-made maps of varying difficulty, Flood Escape 2 offers a unique parkour experience with different abilities such as Swimming, Sliding, Diving, Walljumping, & Ziplining!

📅 NEW CONTENT ADDED REGULARLY
⚠️ Many different modifiers and events to switch things up!
🏅 Hundreds of badges to collect!

Create your own Community Maps for Flood Escape 2, and see other maps made by the community: https://www.roblox.com/games/11951199229

🏆 4x Bloxy/RIA Award Nominee!
🥇 2x Bloxy Award Winner!
